result.description:
Apprentice Parts Interpreter  
  Start your career with one of Australia's leading heavy vehicle and transmission specialists!  
 Programmed Apprenticeships & Traineeships is seeking a motivated  Apprentice Parts Interpreter  to join our host employer based in  Smithfield, NSW . 
 This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is mechanically minded, enjoys problem-solving, and wants to build a long-term career in the heavy vehicle industry. You'll earn while you learn, complete a nationally recognised qualification, and gain hands-on experience working alongside skilled industry professionals in a supportive workshop environment. 
    
  The Role  
 As an Apprentice Parts Interpreter, you will learn how to identify, source, and manage parts for heavy vehicles, transmissions, and related components while supporting day-to-day workshop operations. 
 Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll develop valuable technical knowledge and customer service skills while gaining exposure to a wide range of trucks, machinery, and mechanical systems. 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 Assisting with identifying and ordering parts for heavy vehicles and transmission systems 
 Learning parts catalogues, systems, and inventory processes 
 Supporting workshop operations and technicians 
 Developing strong product knowledge and industry skills 
 Providing professional customer service and support 
 
  What We Offer  
 
 Full-time 36-month apprenticeship 
 Certificate III qualification with all TAFE fees covered 
 Uniform and PPE provided 
 Onsite parking available 
 Dedicated mentors and ongoing support throughout your apprenticeship 
 Hands-on experience in a large and supportive workshop environment 
 Exposure to a wide range of heavy vehicles, components, and machinery 
 Performance-based pay increase within your first six months 
 Genuine long-term career opportunities in a growing industry 
 
  What You'll Bring  
 
 A positive attitude and strong work ethic 
 Reliability and commitment to learning 
 An interest in automotive, mechanical, or technical fields 
 Good communication and teamwork skills 
 Motivation to build a successful career 
 
    
  No previous experience is required.  We're looking for someone with the right attitude, willingness to learn, and passion to develop their skills within the heavy vehicle industry. 
 If you're ready to start a career, not just find a job, apply today! 
   
  Who we are  
 As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to. 
 At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. 
 We welcome and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply. 
   So it's over to you. If you would like to join our team, APPLY now.   
  To learn more about working with Programmed, we encourage you to visit our website.   Please  click here  to apply.
